unresolvedConflicts.subject: Apollo/Argo manager identity
unresolvedConflicts.issue: Argo is presented as an Apollo infrastructure platform while continuing to originate, own, and announce investments under the Argo brand, creating overlap with the separately supplied Apollo Global Management manager.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Retain Argo Infrastructure Partners as the canonical portfolio manager for this census, flag Apollo Global Management as the overlapping parent or successor identity, and perform any cross-manager deduplication only in the later universe-wide reconciliation rather than merging the two manager records here.

notes: Reviewed official portfolio materials and acquisition, closing, financing, and disposition evidence through the as-of date.
All 29 supplied repository records were reconciled: 18 served as primary holding matches and 11 were classified as matched elsewhere.
Pending ownership and duplicate identities were preserved explicitly rather than normalized away.
